acceptance_checks.when: the durable index is deleted and magicite sync --project-root . is run
acceptance_checks.then: all engrams ingest under the strict profile with zero validation errors, the registered count equals the number of .egr.md files on disk, and every one lands verification_status verified
acceptance_checks.verify_method: rm -f .spectra/engrams/skill-graph.db* && uv run magicite sync --project-root . -> synced: 30, validation_errors: [], dangling: []; 30/30 verified by direct query

acceptance_checks.when: every declared needs, composes, and inhibits target is resolved against the registered engram names
acceptance_checks.then: there are zero dangling targets and at least three declared edges join a tranche-2 engram to a tranche-1 engram
acceptance_checks.verify_method: uv run python scripts/dogfood_graph_check.py --edges -> 35 declared edges (26 depends_on, 9 inhibits), 0 dangling, 4 cross-tranche

acceptance_checks.given: each tranche-2 engram's factual claims about src/magicite/**
acceptance_checks.when: every backticked file path and code identifier it names is checked against the tree
acceptance_checks.then: every named symbol, constant, and path exists at the stated location
acceptance_checks.verify_method: uv run python scripts/dogfood_graph_check.py --symbols -> 129 files scanned (src/ + tests/), 30 paths and 49 symbols verified; caught 2 errors during authoring

acceptance_checks.when: the tranche-1 probe set from scripts/dogfood_session.py is re-run unchanged
acceptance_checks.then: every tranche-1 probe still finds its expected engram in the top 3
acceptance_checks.verify_method: uv run python scripts/dogfood_session.py -> 4/4 in top-3 (bar met). NOTE: rank-1 accuracy fell 3/4 -> 2/4; degradation recorded in verification-note.md, not disguised

acceptance_checks.then: ruff check ., mypy src, pytest --cov-fail-under=70, and pytest -m acceptance all pass and magicite tools reports exactly 16 tools
acceptance_checks.verify_method: uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy src && uv run pytest -q --cov=src/magicite --cov-fail-under=70 && uv run pytest -q -m acceptance && uv run magicite tools

acceptance_checks.given: the tranche-2 engrams and every document this change edits
acceptance_checks.then: none presents the enlarged registry as evidence for any hypothesis in docs/01's Falsification Record
acceptance_checks.verify_method: manual review recorded in verification-note.md; two false claims found and corrected under this check
